<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chapter 6 &middot; Linear-Algebraic Methods &#8212; A Lecture Course in the Feynman Style</title>
<style>
  :root { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; color: #1a1a1a; }
  body { max-width: 46rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.5rem 1.2rem 4rem; line-height: 1.55; background: #fff; }
  h1 { font-size: 1.9rem; margin: 2.2rem 0 0.8rem; }
  h2 { font-size: 1.45rem; margin: 2rem 0 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; }
  h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin: 1.6rem 0 0.5rem; }
  h4 { font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 1.3rem 0 0.4rem; }
  pre, code { font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace; }
  code { background: #f2f2f2; padding: 0.05em 0.3em; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.92em; }
  pre { white-space: pre; tab-size: 4; break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid;
        overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #fafafa; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
        font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.35; }
  blockquote { border-left: 3px solid #888; margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.2rem 1rem; color: #333; }
  table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 1rem 0; break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
  th, td { border: 1px solid #bbb; padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; text-align: left; }
  th { background: #f0f0f0; }
  .fig { margin: 1rem 0; text-align: center; break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
  .fig svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
  hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; margin: 2rem 0; }
  .banner { background: #eef6ff; border: 1px solid #bcd6f0; border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 0.8rem 1rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  @page { size: A4; margin: 16mm 15mm; }
  @media print {
    body { max-width: none; padding: 0; font-size: 10.5pt; }
    .no-print { display: none; }
    pre { font-size: 8.8pt; }
    h1, h2, h3, h4 { break-after: avoid; page-break-after: avoid; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="banner no-print">
  <strong>Reference web edition — the working export route.</strong> This page embeds the Chapter&nbsp;6 source <em>byte-identically</em> and renders it locally, with no network and no external pipeline. Every code block carries <code>white-space: pre</code> and <code>break-inside: avoid</code>, so <strong>printing this page to PDF</strong> (Ctrl/Cmd&nbsp;+&nbsp;P &rarr; Save as PDF) produces a PDF in which every code block keeps its exact indentation and stays on a single page. After printing, certify with the publishing toolkit's PDF gate — or simply extract the Python blocks from the printed PDF and compile them. This banner does not print.
</div>
<main id="content"></main>
<script>
var MD_B64 = "";
var TICK = String.fromCharCode(96);
var FENCE = new RegExp('^' + TICK + TICK + TICK);
function escHtml(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}
function inlineMd(s) {
  var t = escHtml(s);
  t = t.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, function (m, c) { return '<code>' + c + '</code>'; });
  t = t.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  t = t.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
  return t;
}
function isBlockStart(s) {
  return FENCE.test(s) || /^#{1,4} /.test(s) || /^>/.test(s) || /^\|/.test(s)
      || /^- /.test(s) || /^\d+\. /.test(s) || /^---\s*$/.test(s);
}
function renderMd(src) {
  var lines = src.split('\n');
  var out = [], i = 0, n = lines.length;
  while (i < n) {
    var line = lines[i];
    if (FENCE.test(line)) {                       // fenced block: verbatim passthrough
      var lang = line.slice(3).trim().toLowerCase();
      var buf = [];
      i++;
      while (i < n && !FENCE.test(lines[i])) { buf.push(lines[i]); i++; }
      if (i < n) i++;
      var text = buf.join('\n');
      if (lang === 'svg') out.push('<div class="fig">' + text + '</div>');
      else out.push('<pre>' + escHtml(text) + '</pre>');
      continue;
    }
    var m = line.match(/^(#{1,4}) (.*)$/);
    if (m) {
      var h = m[1].length;
      out.push('<h' + h + '>' + inlineMd(m[2]) + '</h' + h + '>');
      i++; continue;
    }
    if (/^---\s*$/.test(line)) { out.push('<hr>'); i++; continue; }
    if (/^>/.test(line)) {
      var q = [];
      while (i < n && /^>/.test(lines[i])) { q.push(lines[i].replace(/^>\s?/, '')); i++; }
      out.push('<blockquote>' + q.map(inlineMd).join('<br>') + '</blockquote>');
      continue;
    }
    if (/^\|/.test(line)) {
      var rows = [];
      while (i < n && /^\|/.test(lines[i])) { rows.push(lines[i]); i++; }
      var html = '<table>';
      for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
        var cells = rows[r].replace(/^\|/, '').replace(/\|\s*$/, '').split('|')
                       .map(function (c) { return c.trim(); });
        if (r > 0 && cells.every(function (c) { return c === '' || /^:?-{2,}:?$/.test(c); })) continue;
        var tag = (r === 0) ? 'th' : 'td';
        html += '<tr>' + cells.map(function (c) { return '<' + tag + '>' + inlineMd(c) + '</' + tag + '>'; }).join('') + '</tr>';
      }
      html += '</table>';
      out.push(html);
      continue;
    }
    if (/^\d+\. /.test(line)) {
      var ol = [];
      while (i < n && /^\d+\. /.test(lines[i])) { ol.push('<li>' + inlineMd(lines[i].replace(/^\d+\. /, '')) + '</li>'); i++; }
      out.push('<ol>' + ol.join('') + '</ol>');
      continue;
    }
    if (/^- /.test(line)) {
      var ul = [];
      while (i < n && /^- /.test(lines[i])) { ul.push('<li>' + inlineMd(lines[i].replace(/^- /, '')) + '</li>'); i++; }
      out.push('<ul>' + ul.join('') + '</ul>');
      continue;
    }
    var para = [];
    while (i < n && lines[i].trim() !== '' && !isBlockStart(lines[i])) { para.push(lines[i]); i++; }
    if (para.length) out.push('<p>' + para.map(inlineMd).join('<br>') + '</p>');
    else i++;
  }
  return out.join('\n');
}
(function () {
  var bin = atob(MD_B64);
  var bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (var k = 0; k < bin.length; k++) bytes[k] = bin.charCodeAt(k);
  var md = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
  document.getElementById('content').innerHTML = renderMd(md);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
